change_strategy: All 5 existing lines are kept byte-identical (they are already native-approved). One new line is inserted directly under each locale line, with the same flag + market prefix. Appending the date to the existing lines instead would push the DE line from 84 to about 140 characters (far over the 85-char PDP limit) and would force a re-review of copy that did not change. The em dash replaces a second colon so the English text stays word-for-word with the source and the FR line needs no colon spacing.

length_check.rule: .claude/agents/localization-reviewer.md: delivery badges ≤ 85 characters (PDP buy-box); src/lib/localizer.js uses JS .length > 85
length_check.result: All 5 added lines are ≤ 75 UTF-16 units (≤ 73 code points). Counted by hand, not by tooling; re-check with the localizer guardrail before apply.
length_check.pre_existing_note: The unchanged DE line is 84 code points / 86 UTF-16 units (each flag emoji = 2 code points = 4 UTF-16 units), so by the JS .length check it is already 1 over 85. Not changed because it was out of scope.
length_check.rendering_note: No theme section in theme/ or live-theme/ renders localization.multilingual_delivery_promise; the PDP buy-box (tt-delivery-vat-promise.liquid) renders ops.estimated_delivery_window. The 85-char limit is applied per line here as a guideline.

terminology_notes: Ships = dispatch date, not arrival date. DE uses 'Versand', FR uses 'expédition', matching the source. Do NOT use 'Lieferung' or 'livraison' for this date; that would promise arrival on Dec 02–09.
Pre-Order → DE 'Vorbestellung', FR 'Précommande'. Proposed as glossary additions (pending review), not added to the locked protected_glossary.

'Brazilian Sequoia' is left as an English finish name in DE/FR so it matches the variant option label shoppers see (variant options are English on the store; translations are not pushed live). Reviewer decides: keep, or use 'Brasilianischer Mammutbaum' / 'Séquoia du Brésil' (no glossary entry exists yet).

No VAT figures or existing wording were changed. The existing lines use '19% MwSt.' and 'TVA 20% incluse' without the space the glossary asks for ('inkl. 19 % MwSt.', 'TVA 20 % incluse'). This was already there before this change and is flagged, not fixed.
FR spacing before colons: the new FR text has no ':' ';' '!' '?' after the 'FR:' market label. The existing 'FR:' label convention (no space) is kept so all lines match.
No legal terms (Widerrufsrecht, rétractation, Impressum, mentions légales) were used, so LEGAL_REVIEW is not needed.
